Ничего не править. Результат: result.verdict PASS/FAIL; findings — место, важность, исправление; result.mutants; summary.

result.summary: Verdict PASS. (1) Own mapping criterion -> test, from docs/requirements.yaml REQ-014 and the table of docs/design/REQ-014-traces.md p. 14.1: criterion 1 (finds traces) - traces-check TC-1, TC-1b, TC-2, TC-3/9, TC-4, TC-5, TC-6/7, TC-8, TC-10, TC-11, TC-12/13, TC-17, TC-18, TC-21, TC-22, TC-24, TC-25 and add TC-14/15/16/19/23 - every sub-case of the criterion text (macOS/Linux path, encoded path, NFC/NFD, invisible sign, case, link out of root, a/Zqxwvorg/b, zqxwvorg-api, file name with label k and sha256 prefix checked against the git|sort|sed command, file of hashes and output without the name, <name> placeholder, exception only for this line of this file, open list) has a running test with a value check. Criterion 2 - TC-20 (script check contains npm run traces before npm run test, no ||) plus my own run of npm run traces (code 0); the independent check with SAI_TRACE_LIST is a RELEASE-VALIDATOR step. Criterion 3 - RELEASE-VALIDATOR step, not a test. Criterion 4 - traces-runtime TR-4a..TR-4f. Criterion 5 - traces-readme TD-1..TD-3. Criterion 6 (Q10) - traces-faults TF-1..TF-9, TL-1. Every row of the p. 14.1 table has a test. (2) No skip/todo/only (grep and runner: skipped 0, todo 0); no sleep; every test has its own mkdtemp repository, HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1; processes have timeout 60 s (helpers) / 20 s (TL-1); waits in EN-51 are by waitUntil; chmod and links only inside the temporary folder (AP-020 not triggered). (3) Failure tests check unchanged state (hash of the file of hashes, no lock, folder list before/after in TC-14/16/19, TF-8) and no name/path in the output (TC-9, TC-14, TC-16, TC-18, TF-3, TF-8). (4) Mutants: 42 applied by me on copies in the ORCH scratchpad vtest-req014/ (project tree untouched), 41 killed, 1 equivalent (V40, see findings); my own list overlaps the author's but all numbers below are mine. (5) Race add: 8 rounds x 4 parallel processes by my own script (each round: 1 process code 0, 3 code 2 E_TRACE_BUSY, retried one by one; 4 hashes in file, no lock left in every round) and 6 repeated runs of the TC-19 tests (3/3 pass each). (6) cd tools && npm run check: exit 0, tests 996, pass 996, fail 0, skipped 0, todo 0; npm run traces: exit 0 (files 831, traces 0, skipped 18; 831 because this handoff file is new). traces-* alone: 56/56. (7) TF-7 in-process (mock of fs.openSync through the fs object): works now (kills V14), and is not silently fragile: it also asserts that the neighbour file b.txt was opened, so if check.js stops going through the fs object the test fails loudly, not green; accepted with a LOW note. (8) EN-51 (REQ-013): deepStrictEqual of exactly [t-0001,stop],[t-0002,stop] sorted by task, waits by waitUntil with timeout, kills checked by pid and process group; substantive; diff of the file is 8 lines.
